adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that refreshOAuthTokens is added to webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts (lines 59-79), but the existing webexRefreshedTokenSchema.safeParse(responseBody) at line 88 (after the diff changes) is NOT modified to use parseRefreshTokenResponse like other integrations (zoom, office365, google). Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse in the diff, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, it uses minimumTokenResponseSchema which only requires access_token and a number (expiry). However, webex still uses webexRefreshedTokenSchema directly which likely requires additional fields (scope, token_type, refresh_token, etc.). This inconsistency means synced Webex responses would fail validation. Other integrations like zoom (line 101) and office365 (line 256) were updated to use parseRefreshTokenResponse, but webex was not.
